home.title: We run, we swim, we help — and we publish every euro.
home.sub: We organise the Santa Run, winter sea swims and regattas in the Bay of Kotor. The money goes to local families, children and small businesses — and every payment in and out sits in a public ledger.
home.buildNote: This site is under construction. First event: December.

donate.monthlyDesc: €10 a month is €120 a year — more than most one-off gifts.
donate.feeDesc: So your full amount reaches the cause. Our costs are paid by sponsors.

runner.nudgeDesc: Ask 5 more people. Runners who send 15+ messages raise 76% more. The message is already written — just tap a name.
runner.wallEmpty: No donations yet — be the first.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.individualsHint: Every runner with a published page, ranked by what their page has raised.
leaderboard.teamsHint: A team is a group of runners' pages added together — companies, schools, clubs, families.
leaderboard.emptyTeams: No teams yet — any runner can create one from their page.
leaderboard.teamRaisedBy: raised by {count, plural, one {# member} other {# members}}
leaderboard.teamMembersHint: Every member's page counts towards the team total.

ledger.title: Every euro, both directions
ledger.operationsFund: Operations Fund — from sponsors, entries and grants
ledger.fundsNote: Not one cent of donations goes to salaries or overhead. Sponsors pay for those.
ledger.footNote: Names appear only when the donor chose to show them. Beneficiary identities are protected; documentation is available to an auditor.

dashboard.title: My page
dashboard.signInSub: One email, no password: run partner challenges, earn rewards, and create a fundraising page if you like.
dashboard.createSub: Give your page a name — you'll add the photo, story and goal next. It stays a draft until you publish it.
dashboard.daysLeft: {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} to race day
dashboard.nextActionPublish: Finish your page and publish it — a photo, a goal and three sentences of story.
dashboard.nextActionSelf: Start your page with your own €20. Pages that open at €0 stay at €0.
dashboard.nudgeShare: Ask five more people. Tap Share on your page — the message is ready.
dashboard.publishBlocked: Publishing needs a photo, a goal and a story of at least three sentences.
dashboard.cashSub: Record cash you collected by hand. It counts on your page and the leaderboard once we confirm the hand-in.
dashboard.goalInvalid: Enter the goal as a number, e.g. 300
dashboard.activitySub: Log what you did — it counts on the challenge standings. Strava sync is coming; manual entries work today.
dashboard.nameHint: This is your page's name — what donors and the leaderboard see.
dashboard.editorHint: This is your page as donors will see it. Click the photo, your name, the goal or the story to edit them.
dashboard.storyPlaceholder: Tell people why you run and where the money goes — at least three sentences. Click to write.
dashboard.storyHint: At least three sentences. Enter for a new line; click outside when done.
dashboard.teamCreateSub: A team has its own page: a name, a photo and a few lines about who you are. Other runners can join it and every member's page counts towards the team total.
dashboard.teamDescriptionPlaceholder: Who you are and why you run together.
dashboard.nextActionCreate: Create your first page — pick the event, add a photo, a goal and three sentences.
dashboard.teamsEmpty: You don't captain a team yet.
dashboard.registrationsEmpty: Not registered for any event yet.
dashboard.pagesSub: One page per event you take part in. Each has its own story, goal, team and donate link.
dashboard.createNoEvents: There is no open event you don't already have a page for.
dashboard.teamsSub: Teams you captain. Anyone with a page on the same event can join from their editor; every member's page counts towards the team total.
dashboard.teamJoinsPage: Your page on this event joins the team automatically.
dashboard.teamNoPageYet: You have no page on this event yet — the team is created without you as a member; create a page to join it.
dashboard.createAnotherHeading: Start a page for another event
dashboard.hubEmptySub: Your page is where donations land and what you share. Create one for the event you are joining.
dashboard.shareMessageShort: I'm fundraising for Santamore — {title}. Every euro is published in a public ledger. Support me here:
dashboard.cashDonorPlaceholder: Name shown on the donor wall; empty = anonymous
dashboard.cashNotePlaceholder: Where or how you collected it — for you and staff only
dashboard.cashLogged: Logged — it counts once staff confirm the hand-in.

instructions.introMonthly: Thank you for supporting {campaign} with {amount} a month. Transfer it with the details below and we'll credit it automatically.

instructions.standingOrder: For monthly giving, set up a standing order with your bank using the same reference.
instructions.whatNext: We match transfers usually within one working day. You'll get a receipt, and your gift appears in our public ledger.

admin.linkSent: Check your inbox — we've sent you a sign-in link.
admin.linkError: Could not send the link. Try again.
admin.linkFailed: That sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
admin.codeHint: If the link doesn't work, enter the 6-digit code from the same email.
admin.codeError: Wrong or expired code. Request a new link.
admin.noAccess: This account has no staff access.
admin.uploadHint: Upload the bank's CSV export, map the columns, and confirm the proposed matches.
admin.ambiguousMatch: Several pending pledges share this reference — compare with the statement and choose the right one.
admin.noReference: No payment reference found in this row
admin.actionError: Action failed — check your access and try again.
admin.refundDone: Refunded — correction is in the ledger.
admin.regEmpty: No registrations for this event yet.
admin.wallHint: Hidden messages disappear from the public wall; the donation itself is untouched.
admin.disbNoChapters: No chapters in the database yet.
admin.disbLabelHint: e.g. A family in Tivat, medical costs
admin.galleryHint: Only publish photos with consent. Deleting removes the file permanently.
admin.chartEmpty: No approved donations in the last 30 days.
admin.messagesHint: Contact, volunteer, partner and newsletter submissions from the public site.
admin.eventsHint: Races and challenges. Published events appear on the site, take registrations and can be fundraised for. Nothing is deleted — unpublish instead.
admin.evTiersHint: One per line: label | euros, e.g. Adults | 15
admin.evSlugTaken: That URL slug is already used by another event.
admin.evInvalid: Check the dates and the entry tiers (label | euros).
admin.evCounts: {registrations, plural, one {# registration} other {# registrations}} · {pages, plural, one {# fundraiser page} other {# fundraiser pages}}
admin.campaignsHint: A campaign is the money side: the SEPA reference donors pay to, the suggested amounts on the donate page, the goal and who benefits. Events hang off a campaign.
admin.campAmountsHint: Impact lines exist for €10, €25 and €50 (messages/*.json); other amounts show without one.
admin.demoHint: Fills the next published event with invented teams, runners (photo, story, goal) and approved donations so the leaderboard, pages and admin screens have something to show. Demo donations are real approved rows: they appear in the public ledger until purged. Purge before launch.
admin.demoGenerateHint: Each runner gets a placeholder photo, a story and a goal; each gets a random number of donations up to the maximum.
admin.demoPurgeHint: Deletes every generated runner, team, page and donation — and nothing else. Real rows are untouched.
admin.demoCreated: Created {teams} teams, {users} runners with {fundraisers} pages and {donations} donations.
admin.demoNoEvent: No published event to attach demo data to — publish one under Events first.
admin.demoPartial: Partial run registered: {users} runners, {teams} teams, {fundraisers} pages — purge to clean up.
admin.perksHint: A partner sets a rule (sport, distance, time) and a reward. Qualifying Strava activities mint one-time codes; the partner redeems them with a PIN. See docs/STRAVA.md.
admin.webhookUnconfigured: Set STRAVA_CLIENT_ID, STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET and STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN first.
admin.webhookOk: Subscribed — Strava sends new activities to
admin.perkPinReset: New partner PIN (leave empty to keep)
admin.perkPinHint: Stored hashed. Give it to the partner's staff.
admin.perkAllowManual: Count manual entries (typed in on Strava or logged here, no GPS)
admin.perkRulePreview: Rule as visitors will read it
admin.perkInvalid: Check the distance and pick at least one sport.
admin.sponsorsHint: The sponsor pipeline. Tie a sponsor to a campaign and/or an event. Signed and active cash sponsors count towards the Operations Fund; donations never mix with them.
admin.spOpsNote: Only signed/active cash sponsors count in the public Operations Fund total.
admin.goalInvalidAdmin: Enter the amount as a number, e.g. 1500
admin.perkWindowHint: Required days above 1 make a streak rule: N different days inside the window, one reward per athlete per window. Empty window = the challenge period.
admin.linkRateLimited: Too many sign-in emails in a short time. Wait a few minutes, or use the code from an email you already have.
admin.athletesHint: Everyone who linked Strava, with activity and rewards as counts only. Strava caps connected athletes per app (10 until Developer Program review) — this is how many slots are used.

kontakt.title: Contact
kontakt.sub: Write to us about anything — donations, events, partnerships, or a family that needs help.
kontakt.mapNote: [[PLACEHOLDER: map embed once the registered address is confirmed]]

volunteer.title: Volunteer with us
volunteer.sub: Our events run on neighbours who show up. Tell us who you are and we'll find you a job with a red suit attached.
volunteer.role1: Event day: course marshals, water stations, finish-line medals, the kids' race.
volunteer.role2: Before the event: packet packing, poster runs, translation, photography.
volunteer.role3: All year: cash counting (always in pairs), social media, welcoming new runners.

apply.title: Apply for help
apply.sub: Anyone can apply — no connections required. Families in crisis, children and youth, small local businesses after a disaster, and local organisations.
apply.step1Desc: An open form. No connections required.
apply.step2Desc: Majority not employed by us; conflicts declared and recused; criteria published.
apply.step3Desc: And published in the ledger within 30 days of that, with documentation.
apply.contactLabel: How can we reach you (phone or email)
apply.descriptionLabel: Tell us what happened and what would help
apply.success: Received. The committee reviews applications against published criteria; we will contact you either way.

events.title: Events
events.sub: Joyful, physical, public — and every euro they raise lands in the ledger.
events.signInSub: One email — the same account runs your fundraising page.
events.waiver1: I take part at my own risk and confirm I am medically fit for the activity I chose.
events.waiver2: I understand minors take part with guardian consent, and that photos and video from the event may be published — I can opt out at the info point.
events.waiver3: Withdrawal, transfer and bad-weather rules are part of the event terms.
events.waiverFull: Read the full event terms and waiver
events.waiverAccept: I have read and accept the event terms and waiver
events.payInstructions: One step left: transfer your entry fee with the reference below and we'll confirm your place, usually within one working day.
events.opsNote: Entry fees fund the event and our team (Operations Fund) — donations still go 100% to beneficiaries.
events.paidNote: Entry fee received. See you at the start line.
events.noFeeNote: No entry fee due. See you at the start line.

gallery.title: The bay, on its feet
gallery.sub: Photos from our events — published with consent, credited to the people who took them.
gallery.empty: Photos from our next event will appear here — published with consent.

news.title: What happened, and what's next
news.sub: Event announcements, results and reports — the same facts as the ledger, in sentences.
news.empty: No posts yet. The first one lands with our next event.

consent.label: Cookie notice
consent.text: We use privacy-friendly analytics (Plausible) only if you agree. No ad trackers, ever.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.sub: What we are raising for right now, how far along it is, and who the money reaches. Every euro in and out is in the public ledger.
campaigns.promise: 100% of donations reach beneficiaries. Fees are covered separately and shown in the ledger.
campaigns.fundraisersLink: See the fundraisers and teams running for it →

perks.title: Partner challenges
perks.sub: Run the rule, earn the reward. Partners in the Bay set a daily challenge — do it, and show the code at their counter.
perks.step1: Connect Strava to your Santamore account once.
perks.step2: Do the run. Strava tells us; a qualifying activity earns a code.
perks.step3: Open the code on your phone and show the QR at the partner. They tap once and it is yours.
perks.empty: No active challenges at the moment.
perks.leftToday: {count, plural, =0 {None left today} one {# left today} other {# left today}}
perks.howNote: Rewards need a connected Strava account with public activities.
perks.ruleElevation: with at least {elevation} m of climbing
perks.ruleCaps: Up to {perUser, plural, one {# reward} other {# rewards}} per athlete per day.
perks.ruleValid: Codes are valid for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
perks.redeemHint: Enter your partner PIN to mark this reward as redeemed. It can be redeemed once.

redeemOutcome.locked: Too many attempts — try again in 15 minutes.
redeemOutcome.revoked: This code is no longer valid (the activity was removed).

perks.awardNote: This page shows the reward only — never the underlying Strava activity.
perks.rulePace: at a pace of {pace} /km or faster
perks.ruleDaysPeriod: on {days} different days during the challenge
perks.noPageNeeded: No fundraising page needed: sign in with your email, connect Strava, run.

strava.title: Strava
strava.sub: Connect Strava to earn partner rewards for your runs and to count activities on challenge standings.
strava.shareLabel: Show my activities on public challenge standings
strava.shareHint: Off by default. Your activities are otherwise visible only to you; rewards show only the reward, never the run.
strava.disconnectHint: Disconnecting revokes our access at Strava and deletes every Strava activity we stored. Rewards you already earned stay valid.
strava.connectSub: We read your public activities (distance, time, date) to check partner challenge rules. Nothing is posted to Strava.
strava.privacyNote: You can disconnect at any time here or from Strava's settings; we then delete the activities we stored.
strava.statusConnected: Strava connected. Today's runs are being checked against the challenges.
strava.statusScope: Strava did not grant activity access — please allow "View data about your activities".
strava.statusTaken: That Strava account is already linked to another Santamore account.
strava.statusState: The sign-in link expired — start again.
strava.statusUnconfigured: Strava is not configured on this site yet.
strava.syncDone: Synced {imported, plural, one {# activity} other {# activities}}, {awards, plural, =0 {no new rewards} one {# new reward} other {# new rewards}}.
strava.syncThrottled: Already synced recently — try again in a few minutes.
strava.activitiesEmpty: No runs in the last 8 weeks. Record one with the Strava app — it appears here within a minute of finishing.
strava.unconfiguredStaffHint: Staff: set STRAVA_CLIENT_ID, STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET and STRAVA_WEBHOOK_VERIFY_TOKEN, then register the webhook under Admin → Partner perks (docs/STRAVA.md).
strava.nurtureHeading: Your runs could also raise money
strava.nurtureBody: You are connected and earning rewards. A fundraising page turns the same runs into support for families in the Bay — a photo, a goal, three sentences.
strava.statusCredentials: Strava rejected this site's app credentials. Staff: check STRAVA_CLIENT_ID and STRAVA_CLIENT_SECRET in the deployment.
strava.progressEmpty: No active partner challenges right now.
strava.progressEarned: Reward earned for this window — see it below.
strava.scopePartialHint: Private runs are not included yet — reconnect and allow access to all activities.
strava.manualEntry: Manual entry — counts only where the partner allows it
strava.trendCaption: Distance per week over the last {weeks} weeks
strava.trendEmpty: Your weekly trend appears after your first synced run.
strava.rewardsNoneReady: Nothing waiting — every reward you earned is redeemed or expired.
strava.autoSyncNote: New runs arrive on their own within a minute; the page also refreshes when you open it.
strava.trendEmptyDisconnected: Connect Strava to see kilometres per week.
strava.activitiesEmptyDisconnected: Your runs from the last 8 weeks appear here once connected.

giving.title: My giving
giving.sub: Every donation made with {email}, with receipts and the ledger entry. Donations you made anonymously are still listed here — only you can see this page.
giving.feesNote: Includes {amount} you added to cover fees — thank you, it keeps 100% of donations for beneficiaries.
giving.monthlyManageNote: Changing the amount or cancelling: self-service arrives with the card rail; until then write to us.
giving.empty: No donations with this email yet.
giving.pendingSepa: We have not matched a transfer for this pledge yet. Quote this reference in the transfer, and we credit it usually within one working day.
giving.privacyNote: Matching is by your verified sign-in email. If you gave with a different address, sign in with that one to see those donations.
